card.title: Galaxy A515 Black Screen After 1st logo

source.title: Galaxy A515 Black Screen After 1st logo

claims.statement: A Galaxy A515 that stops on a black screen after the first boot logo (no second logo, no bootloop) yet boots fully with the screen unplugged usually has a liquid-damaged display.
Besides replacing the display, it can be repaired by jumpering display FPC pads 5 and 7 with fine wire.

procedure: Confirm the device boots fully with the screen disconnected.
Replace the display, or pretin pads 5 and 7 and bridge them with 0.02 mm wire; UV-cure.
card.caveats: Applies only when every listed symptom matches. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
